items.title: Linux Ransomware Pay2Key Attacking Servers, Virtualization Platforms, and Cloud Environments
items.description: Linux has long been considered a more secure operating system than Windows, but that reputation is being tested. A ransomware group known as Pay2Key, attributed to Iranian threat actors, has developed a Linux variant that is actively targeting organizational servers, virtualization hosts, and cloud workloads.
